scripts.build: bun run prepare.ts && cargo build --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --manifest-path Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run prepare.ts && bun run ../../scripts/check-rust-tests.ts Cargo.toml && cargo test --locked --manifest-path Cargo.toml
